findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_queue.py `_prepare` calls `generated_files(root, "HEAD")` twice, in the unrecorded-update recovery path and in the main preparation path, with no try/except. `prepare_derived_specs` catches only `workers.WorkerError`. A `TaskFreshnessError` from a malformed declaration, or from a `check` missing from `[settings].full_commands`, therefore escapes as an unclassified exception. It is neither `IntegrationRepairNeeded` nor `QueueError`. This happens even for candidates that have no overlap with the generated file.
findings.summary: The queue reads the generated-file declaration with no handling for a declaration the reader rejects. The `check` requirement makes rejection a new failure mode on the default branch. The spec says only that reading fails explicitly. It does not say how the queue treats that failure.

findings.evidence: task_content_identity.py `review_exclusion` raises `TaskFreshnessError` when `main_branch` is absent, when there is no merge base, or (through `generated_files`) when `paths.checks` is missing. About eight test fixtures had to gain `dev-platform/checks.toml` plus `paths.checks`: test_model_routing, test_independent_review, test_integration_advance_receipts, test_central_dogfood_lifecycle, and others. `parallel_lifecycle_acceptance.py` was edited the same way. Projects without `paths.checks` will fail identity computation. The design and proposal do not address this.
findings.summary: `review_exclusion` now always reads the declaration at the main merge base. Every review or composition identity computation therefore needs `main_branch`, `origin/<main>` and a check configuration. The completion-lifecycle spec covers a missing configuration, but the design does not discuss this wider reach. The Rollout cost paragraph covers only digest changes.

findings.evidence: `.managed-task.json` `artifacts` lists proposal.md, design.md, specs/publication-queue/spec.md and tasks.md. It omits specs/completion-lifecycle/spec.md. The proposal Impact section names completion-lifecycle among the affected specs, and the candidate adds specs/completion-lifecycle/spec.md.
findings.summary: The imported package metadata does not list the completion-lifecycle delta spec, although that spec is part of the active delta.
